mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation higher and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: INDPRO index drops > 2% MoM but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by the HOUST series, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST drops > 10% YoY but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate loans (RSAFS) grow faster than 10% year-over-year, it signals an overheating housing market that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the wealth effect boosts consumer spending.
failure_condition: RSAFS YoY growth exceeds 10% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows faster than 200,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a strengthening labor market that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending boosts corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS MoM growth > 200k for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: PAYEMS grows > 200k for 2 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3% year-over-year, it signals rising inflationary pressures that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.
